critique: The render has the correct orange fire/smoke palette and a brief rightward directional drift between 0.01 and 0.08, but it reads as a soft, rounded orange cloud rather than an explosive muzzle flash. It lacks a hot yellow/near-white core, sharp high-energy particle definition, and a convincingly fast burst-and-dissipate silhouette. The two frames remain similarly dense and blob-like, so the motion feels sustained rather than a crisp flash.

suggestions.why: Shift the primary particle color toward hot yellow so the flash has a brighter combustion core instead of reading as uniformly orange smoke.
Reduce excessive particle feathering; the current 46 value merges the particles into a soft circular blob, while a lower feather preserves explosive edge definition.
Shorten the emission window so the effect behaves like a discrete muzzle-flash burst rather than continuously replenishing a similarly dense cloud through the 0.08-second frame.
